# Reliability Engineering for AI Services

> Set, measure and defend the reliability standards of an AI service: objectives, capacity, degraded modes, incidents, safe releases and verified models. SDAIA Academy course AE-403, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 17,886 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Objectives that match what users need](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/slides/day1.md): Indicators and objectives for latency, availability and answer quality, sliced by language; sessions: AI services fail differently, Indicators for latency and quality, Objectives and error budgets, Objectives for multi-step tasks; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/slides/day1.html; about 4,395 tokens
- [Day 2: Capacity and failure](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/slides/day2.md): Admission limits from measured goodput, degraded modes and chaos experiments; sessions: Capacity with headroom, Admission control and shedding, Degraded modes, Chaos experiments; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/slides/day2.html; about 3,967 tokens
- [Day 3: Incidents and safe releases](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/slides/day3.md): Burn-rate alerts on quality, incident leadership, canaries and blameless learning; sessions: Finding silent regressions, Running an incident, Canary and rollback, Learning from incidents; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/slides/day3.html; about 3,886 tokens
- [Day 4: Integrity and readiness](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/slides/day4.md): Model provenance, signatures, bills of materials and production readiness reviews; sessions: The model supply chain, Signing and verification, Bills of materials and admission, Production readiness reviews; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/slides/day4.html; about 3,908 tokens
- [Capstone: Readiness review defences](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/slides/capstone.md): A production readiness review defended before a panel, with a live fault to diagnose; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/slides/capstone.html; about 1,168 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: What the uptime check missed](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/labs/D1_1_uptime_blind_spots.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Four indicators from one day](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/labs/D1_2_indicators.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Objectives, budget and release policy](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/labs/D1_3_error_budgets.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Indicators for the redelivery flow](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/labs/D1_4_task_objectives.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Goodput curve and operating point](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/labs/D2_1_goodput_operating_point.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: A cap and priority shedding](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/labs/D2_2_admission_shedding.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Fallback model and cached answers](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/labs/D2_3_degraded_modes.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Outage, timeout and retry storm](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/labs/D2_4_chaos.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: A burn-rate alert on quality](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/labs/D3_1_quality_burn_rate.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Game day: a model-update regression](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/labs/D3_2_game_day.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Canary with automated rollback](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/labs/D3_3_canary_rollback.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: Blameless review and regression test](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/labs/D3_4_blameless_review.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: Provenance and the tampered file](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/labs/D4_1_provenance.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: Sign and verify a model folder](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-403/labs/D4_2_signing.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
